dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you doing?

dialogues.speaker: Iron Ingot
dialogues.text: Actually, the mine at the Chasm hasn't been fully reopened yet, so I have nothing to do at the moment.

dialogues.speaker: Iron Ingot
dialogues.text: So I came here to study some astronomy from this nice lady. Learn something new, you know.

dialogues.speaker: Iron Ingot
dialogues.text: Take a look... Doesn't it look amazing from this angle...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You're not talking about constellations, are you?

dialogues.speaker: Iron Ingot
dialogues.text: Hey, cut that out! Can't you see I'm watching the... uh, stars, very intently!?

dialogues.speaker: Iron Ingot
dialogues.text: Or would you like to follow... I mean, would you like to learn about astronomy from this lady?

dialogues.speaker: Iron Ingot
dialogues.text: Shoo, shoo! First come, first served, don't you get it? Now take these ores and scram, and stop disturbing our star-gazing!

dialogues.speaker: Iron Ingot
dialogues.text: Hello, how are you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you doing?

dialogues.speaker: Iron Ingot
dialogues.text: Actually, the mine at the Chasm has been sealed off. I have nothing to do at the moment.

dialogues.speaker: Iron Ingot
dialogues.text: So I came here to study some astronomy from this nice lady. Learn something new, you know.

dialogues.speaker: Iron Ingot
dialogues.text: Take a look... Doesn't it look amazing from this angle...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...Bye.

dialogues.speaker: Iron Ingot
dialogues.text: Goodbye, take care now!

dialogues.speaker: Iron Ingot
dialogues.text: It's so beautiful...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You like star gazing too?

dialogues.speaker: Iron Ingot
dialogues.text: I sure do! Just because I'm a miner with not much education doesn't mean I'm any less curious about the night sky than you!

dialogues.speaker: Iron Ingot
dialogues.text: Look at this one... So exquisitely composed, so graceful and lovely... Awesome.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you talking about the constellations?

dialogues.speaker: Iron Ingot
dialogues.text: Nah, who's looking at the constellations...

dialogues.speaker: Iron Ingot
dialogues.text: ...I mean, yes! That's right, the constellations!

dialogues.speaker: Iron Ingot
dialogues.text: Look at that constellation, Mysterious Adeptus of the Highest Heaven Soaring Across the Skies. Don't you think it looks like... Y'know?
